# DISPATCH — the agent roster for THE PLAN (2026-09-06, main session)

Companion to `docs/2026-09-06-THE-PLAN.md` (THE PLAN wins on any conflict; this file only sequences it and
writes each agent's steps). Every agent reads THE PLAN §0–§4, §6, §7 first, then ONLY its own brief here.

Paths: **app root** = `D:\Labs\map-goblin\story\story` (run every `node scripts/...` and `npm run check` here).
**docs** = `D:\Labs\map-goblin\story\docs` (THE PLAN, art bible, scene book, inventories, FINDINGS, walks).
Dev server: Vite on :5180, PID 26288 (`netstat -ano | findstr :5180`). Never restart it. No browser tabs —
frames come from `node scripts/measure/frame.mjs` only (§4.1).

## Staffing (Nayan, 2026-09-06 — replaces THE PLAN §5.0 "every agent is Sonnet")

| role | model | does |
|---|---|---|
| EXPLORER | Sonnet | read-only. Measures the baseline for a build unit and hands the builder NUMBERS: positions, pixel values, screen bboxes, reproduction commands. Writes only `scripts/measure/<unit>-*.mjs` and frames. Never edits `src/`. |
| BUILDER | Opus | edits the unit's files exactly as its brief says, runs the §4.6 look loop, proves its own gates, reports by §7. |
| VERIFIER | Sonnet | did not build it. Re-derives every gate with its own script and its own frames. Writes FINDINGS rows. PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED. |

Three agents at once, never more. A unit runs EXPLORE → BUILD → VERIFY; a builder's brief is written only after its
explorer's numbers are in (no invented numbers, THE PLAN's rule). Stop conditions (THE PLAN §5.0) apply to all three
roles; on any stop the main session halts the wave and asks Nayan before anything downstream continues.

## Queue and waves

```
wave 1  T-MOCKREADY (Opus, tooling)   W3c-explore (Sonnet)   W1-verify (Sonnet)
wave 2  W3c-build (Opus)              WS-a-explore (Sonnet)  [W1-verify finishing]
wave 3  WS-a-build (Opus)             W3c-verify4 (Sonnet)   W9-explore (Sonnet)
wave 4  W9-build (Opus)               WS-a-verify (Sonnet)   W2-explore (Sonnet)
wave 5  W2-build (Opus)               W9-verify (Sonnet)     WIRE-explore (Sonnet: W5a, W8c, W6d, WS-b)
wave 6+ WIRE builds (Opus, one file each) + one verifier → W4 → W5b/W5c → W6a/b/e → W6c (after W9) →
        W7 (main session writes tavern RULINGS first) → W8a/b/d/f → W8e (after W2) → WT → W10
```

Briefs below are written in full for waves 1–3. Waves 4+ get their step-level briefs when their explorer reports
land; their gates are already fixed in THE PLAN §5 and are not restated here.

## WAVE 1

### T-MOCKREADY — measurement tooling (Opus, builder)

**Files:** `src/MockSheet.tsx` · `scripts/measure/frame.mjs` · `src/App.tsx` (DEV block only) · NEW
`scripts/measure/png.mjs` · `scripts/measure/README.md` (add rows). Nothing else.

**Why.** Mock-route captures race the async class load (`loadMock` in `MockSheet.tsx` awaits each `import()`;
`frame.mjs` mock mode only counts rAFs, `RAF_PROBE` / `minFrames: 20`), so `wsb-sky-mock-perf-z1.png` came back blank.
Every later gate reads pixels off PNGs, and nothing in the repo decodes a PNG. Verifiers also need THREE in-page.

**Steps.**
1. `MockSheet.tsx`, the component that owns `loaded` / `useFrame` (the one taking `ids, zoom, family, aim, onNotes`):
   - On mount: `document.documentElement.dataset.mockReady = ''`.
   - Add `const readyTicks = useRef(-1)`. In the effect that already ends with `setLoaded((n) => n + 1)`, set
     `readyTicks.current = 3` right after that call. In the existing `useFrame`, `if (readyTicks.current > 0 &&
     --readyTicks.current === 0) document.documentElement.dataset.mockReady = '1';`. Three ticks so the camera
     re-solve effect keyed on `loaded` has run and rendered before the flag is raised.
   - Unknown-class notes (`id + ': unknown class'`) still end the effect → flag still raises (a blank route with a
     note is a valid capture; the note is in the DOM).
2. `frame.mjs` `pollReady`, `mode === 'mock'` branch: evaluate
   `document.documentElement.dataset.mockReady === '1'` in the same `Runtime.evaluate` as the `RAF_PROBE`; return only
   when BOTH hold (flag true AND `n >= minFrames`). Keep the `t` branch byte-identical.
3. `App.tsx`, inside the existing DEV-gated block that sets `dataset.frameReady` (grep `FRAME_T`): add
   `(window as unknown as { __THREE?: unknown }).__THREE = THREE;` once (import `* as THREE from 'three'` if not
   already imported). DEV-only, same gate as `?hud=1`.
4. NEW `scripts/measure/png.mjs`, node stdlib only (`fs`, `zlib`), no npm:
   - `export function readPng(path)` → `{ width, height, channels, data }` (Uint8Array, row-major RGB or RGBA).
     Handle bit depth 8, colour type 2 (RGB) and 6 (RGBA), non-interlaced, all five scanline filters (None, Sub,
     Up, Average, Paeth per the PNG spec). Throw with a clear message on anything else.
   - `export function patch(img, x, y, w, h)` → `{ r, g, b, lum, rb }`: mean sRGB bytes, mean LINEAR luminance
     using THE PLAN §2's piecewise `lin()` (never `x^2.2`), and mean `r − b` in bytes.
   - CLI: `node scripts/measure/png.mjs <file.png> --rect x,y,w,h [--rect …]` prints one line per rect:
     `rect x,y,w,h  R G B  lum 0.xxxx  R-B ±n`. `--selftest` encodes a 6×4 RGBA image with each filter type on a
     different row using `zlib.deflateSync`, decodes it, and asserts byte equality; prints `selftest ok`.
5. Proof (all frames to `docs/build/walks/world/`, names per §4.1 step 7, prefix `tmr-`):
   - `node scripts/measure/png.mjs --selftest` → `selftest ok`.
   - `node scripts/measure/frame.mjs --mock sky --zoom 1 --out docs/build/walks/world/tmr-01-mock-sky-perf-z1-a.png`
     twice (…`-b.png`); `fc /b` (or `cmp`) the two → identical. READ the PNG: the leaf bank is visible beside the
     hero (not the blank of `wsb-sky-mock-perf-z1.png`).
   - Same for `--mock foliage --rig prep --zoom 4` (…`tmr-02-…`), and `--mock sheet` (…`tmr-03-…`, `--timeout 60000`).
   - `node scripts/measure/frame.mjs --t 65.5 --curtain 0 --out docs/build/walks/world/tmr-04-t65.5-S8-perf-paper.png`
     then `png.mjs … --rect 0,0,40,40` → within 6/255 per channel of paper `#F7F5F0` darkened by the grain layer;
     report the numbers (this is the baseline WS-a measures against).
   - `npm run check` passes.
6. README rows for `png.mjs` and the `mockReady` contract (one line each). Report by §7.

**Stop if:** the `mockReady` flag never raises on `?mock=sky` (report the DOM note text), or a PNG from
`Page.captureScreenshot` is not colour type 2/6 depth 8 (report the IHDR bytes; do not add a dependency).

**Measure and report, with the command for each:**

   produced: grep the bible between `### 4.7` and `## 5` for `Reproduce`, `?mock=transfer`, `probe`. State the exact
   procedure (route, family, which patch is UP/KEY/VERT/SHADE/LEE, how pixels were read). If it is not
   reproducible from the repo, say so — that is a finding, not a blocker.

   `interior`) + `png.mjs`, read the UP and KEY white-albedo patches: R, G, B, R−B. Compare with the bible's
   `#E8E8E8 / 0` and `#F7F5F2 / +5`. Report the deltas.
3. **Baseline page, today.** `frame.mjs --t` at 6.4, 20.0, 33.0, 40.0, 53.0, 58.5, 65.5, `--curtain 0`, 1440×900.
   For each: `png.mjs --rect 300,0,<w−300>,18 --rect 300,<h−18>,<w−300>,18` (top and bottom bands, HUD excluded, w/h = the PNG's real size) → R G B lum R−B, and the
   chapter token the timeline holds at that t (`skyDusk`, `skyDay`, `skyOvercast`, `skyHearth`, `skyVellum`,
   `skyDawn`, `skyBoard` — hex from `palette.ts`). This is the BEFORE table.

## WAVE 3

### WS-a-build — paper background, wash, hemisphere tint (Opus, builder)

**Files (main-session-authorised, this unit only, these sites only):**
- `src/styles.css`: `:root { --sky }` comment/default and the `body::after` gradient.
- `src/film/Film.tsx`: (a) the `useEffect` that creates `scene.fog`; (b) the `useFrame` block that sets `--sky`;
  (c) the `<hemisphereLight>` JSX → a `useRef`'d light whose `.color` is set per frame. Nothing else in the file.
- `src/film/world.ts` + `src/film/rig.ts` (`World` type): add `air: THREE.Color` (built at `skyDusk`, like
  `keyColor`).
- `src/film/timeline.ts`: ONLY the two helpers `sky()` and `skyCut()` — their target becomes `world.air`
  instead of `(scene.fog as THREE.FogExp2).color`. No call site changes.

**Steps.**
1. Fog: `scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(paper, 0.0085)` (paper token from `palette.ts`); density unchanged.
2. Air: `world.air` tweened by the timeline exactly where fog was. Per frame in `Film.tsx`:
   `skyCss.copy(world.air).lerp(paperColor, curtain.value)` → `--sky` (same lerp as today).
3. Wash: `body::after` = `linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--sky) 0%, var(--paper) <H>%)` and `html, body {
   background: var(--paper) }`. `<H>` is the horizon stop: 52 % at 1440×900 (the current gradient's mid stop; the
   only committed number). Full-token top stop, straight to paper, no third stop, no `color-mix` with foreign hexes.
4. Hemisphere: **NOT TOUCHED in this round.** WS-a-explore (`node scripts/measure/wsa-hemi-tint.mjs`, k = 0
   reproduces the bible's `#E8E8E8` / `#F7F5F2` byte-exact) found the largest tint k that keeps |R−B| ≤ 5 and
   |ΔL| ≤ 3/255 on UP and KEY is 0.20 for `skyDay`, 0.10 for `skyOvercast`, and **0 for `skyDusk`, `skyHearth`,
